subject: Applying chosen keywords and merchandising decisions to Etsy listing fields — title, the 13 tags, category/attributes,…

evals.prompt: Define etsy in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the etsy skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind etsy. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "Research a full keyword universe and cluster search intent before any listing exists (use keywords)". Should etsy activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force etsy onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to seo-strategy, printify, keywords, shopify.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "Optimize an Etsy listing title, description, attributes, and 13 tags without exceeding the 20-character tag limit". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying etsy.
Place etsy among its adjacent skills (seo-strategy, printify, keywords, shopify). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.

evals.prompt: Name one plausible misconception about etsy and correct it with a mechanism-level explanation.
